title: pretty ELYAN|Plus Size Printed Half Sleeve Pleated A-Line Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This?floor length wedding guest dress feels romantic, soft, and easy to wear. The V-neckline opens up the upper body in a really flattering way, while the floaty sleeves add light coverage through the arms. The waist is gently defined, and the slit gives the skirt a bit more shape and movement. It works beautifully for weddings, garden venues, and dressed-up daytime celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
